text:
maria: Quick heads-up — small hotfix landed in PR #4783 for embeddings route (reduces intermittent 503s). Need expedited run through staging -> prod in the 2h change window. Requesting staging gatekeeper consent to shorten canary window.

trevor: what are rollback criteria?

maria: rollback plan: pin service image back to image:emd-1.3.7-prev, unset new feature flag, and rollout rollback via deploybot. Success criteria to keep: latency P95 < 350ms and 503 rate < 0.1% over 5m. If 503s > 1% during canary -> immediate revert.

lina: PM +1 on urgency, release notes updated (short bullet + risk section). Link: https://go/redwood/relnotes/4783

ci-bot: preflight checks passed: unit tests ok, integration smoke ok, security scan passed.

maria: deploy commands i ran in staging:
```
# pinned image for quick rollback
IMAGE=redwood/embeddings:1.3.8-hotfix-4783
./deploybot release --env=staging --image=$IMAGE --canary=0.1 --timeout=15m
```

deploybot: Starting staged rollout to staging · release_id=rel_2026_03_21_4783 · canary=10% · start_ts=3125005100

deploybot: Canary instances healthy (5/5) · latency p95=290ms · 503s=0.02%

sre-oncall: I'm monitoring logs and traces. Observed small GC spike at t+2m but looks within baseline. I'm +1 to fast-track to prod if prod health check passes in the next 10m.

trevor: product/ux ok with short canary? lina?

lina: yes, we've notified support and added customer-facing note. PM stands by. +1

maria: asking ops for explicit approve to skip full 30m canary and do quick push: @sre-oncall @deploybot can we move to prod in the change window?

sre-oncall: approved to accelerate. Conditions: 1) prod canary at 5% for 10m, 2) realtime SLO alerting on, 3) immediate rollback script ready.

deploybot: Scheduling prod rollout · target=prod · release_id=rel_2026_03_21_4783 · canary=5% · est_duration=12m

maria: kickoff command (will run in 30s):
```
./deploybot release --env=prod --image=$IMAGE --canary=0.05 --timeout=10m --notify=#oncall
```

deploybot: Prod canary started · 2 instances (5%) · ts=3125005250

deploybot: Prod canary health ok · latency p95=305ms · 503s=0.04% · metrics_stable=TRUE

sre-oncall: watching APM and error budget. all green so far. proceeding to full roll at 05%.

maria: rolling to 100% in 2 waves, waiting for final green at 5m mark.

deploybot: Rollout complete to prod · 100% · ts=3125005350 · release_id=rel_2026_03_21_4783

lina: thanks all — release notes pushed, tickets updated, support notified. filing quick postmortem template in case we see anything. :tada:

trevor: nice work. keep an eye on downstream retriers for next 24h.

maria: will monitor and keep thread updated. closing once stable for 1h.

ci-bot: Deployment summary attached: tests=passed, canary_health=green, rollback_tag=image:emd-1.3.7-prev
